caseNameFull: Mark Craig, in Error v. Commonwealth of Kentucky
summary: In error to the Hardin County Quarterly Court, the State of Kentucky.
attorneys: Mr. Hobson L. James for the plaintiff in error. Mr. Arthur H. Mann for the defendant in error.

opinions.text: Judgment reversed with costs and cause remanded for further proceedings upon confession of error by the defendant in error and motion of Mr. Arthur H. Mann for the defendant in error.
